stops.name: Ozark Hollow Salvage
stops.flavor: Down a gravel track, past two dogs. Everything is for sale and nothing is priced.

stops.name: Lakeshore Auto Salvage
stops.flavor: Lake wind has taken the paint off every shell in the yard. The mechanicals are immaculate.

stops.name: Rust Belt Auto Graveyard
stops.flavor: Rows of Detroit iron going back fifty years. The owner knows every casting number by heart.

stops.name: Brickyard Machine Werks
stops.flavor: Ex-Indy fabricators who got bored of open wheels. Precision costs.

stops.name: Bluegrass Machine Co.
stops.flavor: A horse barn with a dyno cell in it. They only work on motors they think are worth it.
